headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, led by Junior Caminero's 3 hits, 3 home runs, and 6 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Seattle Mariners 5-1, with Bubba Chandler earning the win. The Oakland Athletics secured a 9-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants, with Victor Bericoto leading the offense and Landen Roupp pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's availability. Tony Santillan has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Cincinnati Reds due to a left oblique strain. Ryne Nelson has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Arizona Diamondbacks with a strained right elbow. Other injured players include Johan Rojas (Philadelphia Phillies), Cody Freeman (Texas Rangers), Marcus Semien (New York Mets), Zack Gelof (Athletics), Spencer Horwitz (Pittsburgh Pirates), and Steven Matz (Tampa Bay Rays).

The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade with the New York Mets, sending third baseman Cole Mathis to the Mets. The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Houston Astros acquired SS Marcus Brown from the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Washington Nationals traded RHP Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Astros also traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Royals in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 13-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals, behind a standout performance from their offense. Junior Caminero led the charge with 3 hits, 3 home runs, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Bubba Chandler earning the win. Brandon Lowe led the Mariners' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Giants 9-6**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 9-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants, with Victor Bericoto leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Landen Roupp pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros edged out the Detroit Tigers 2-1, with Tatsuya Imai pitching 6.0 innings of shutout ball, striking out 10 batters and walking just 1.

top_news.title: **Reds Pitcher Sidelined with Injury**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have placed RHP Tony Santillan on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain, effective retroactive to June 23, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade, while sending third baseman Cole Mathis to the New York Mets.
